name: Hover Grid
description: A grid of items divided by hairlines, where one soft highlight glides to whichever item is under the pointer or focused.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; description: string; icon?: LucideIcon; href?: string }[]
props.description: The items, in reading order. icon is a lucide-react icon component. With href the whole item is a link, and keyboard focus moves the highlight too.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at full width. The grid follows its container: one column when narrow, two at medium widths.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element, which is a size container.
